comment: cmd.c handler_change_autocompletions() witness: #optionsfull opens the autocompletions menu, which preselects every AUTOCOMPLETE command; 'd' adds #attributes and Enter keeps the rest. parseautocomplete() then sets each picked command, so '#cha' still completes to chat and '#at' now completes to attributes.
